name: staff-role-list-parent-id-fix
title: Fix staff role list parent id serialization
description: Map lean ParentRole _id values to the non-null GraphQL id field so the add-employee modal can consume roleList data from MongoDB.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Flow traced: Mongo Role/ParentRole -> UserQuery.roleList -> GraphQL Role.parentRole -> Apollo roleList -> EmployeeFormModal validation. The selected restaurant and role query both run; serialization failed because ParentRole.id is non-null while populated lean values exposed only _id. Added the missing ParentRole id resolver and a focused regression test. Targeted tests, build, and browser checks were not run because the connector environment has no runnable checkout.
